hook: 5 things you missed in crypto today

stories.text: Bitcoin down 40% as ETFs bleed and Strategy exits
stories.summary: Bitcoin is down 40% in six months as ETFs bleed and Strategy eyes selling BTC. Analysts explain what's really behind the drop.

stories.text: Money flees Bitcoin ETFs for Hyperliquid record streak
stories.summary: Bitcoin ETFs lost a record $4.5 billion in a month while Hyperliquid's new funds have never had a losing week. Here's why money is moving.

stories.text: Trump opposes Bitcoin tax, SEC admits ETF mistakes
stories.summary: Trump says bitcoin shouldn't be taxed as a payment method. SEC admits past crypto ETF mistakes, promises neutral approach. BTC tests $62K.

stories.text: Robinhood Chain launches with stock tokens and 7% yield
stories.summary: Robinhood Chain launched its Arbitrum-based Layer 2 with tokenized stocks in 120+ countries and a 7% USDG lending product powered by Morpho for U.S. users.

stories.text: ENS founder blocks renewal using 3.26M tokens
stories.summary: ENS founder Nick Johnson used 3.26 million tokens to block a Security Council renewal, sparking calls to dissolve the DAO and raising centralization.
